card.name: Digits inside percentage figures
card.fires_on: A digit token in a number that is followed by a percent sign, often the first or second digit of a range like 1 to 2% or a two-digit value like 84%. Seen in drug-interaction and population-frequency statements.

modes.label: Start of a range
modes.description: The first digit of a percentage range after 'to' or a dash.

modes.label: Digit in a two-digit percent
modes.description: The second digit of a change or incidence figure just before the % sign.
modes.example: decreased by 8<<4>>%, with a corresponding decrease in AUC
